Grids in Ray Tracing: A Comprehensive Survey
It covers grid traversal algorithms, building techniques, and hierarchical grid approaches. It also discusses how ray tracing performance depends on both the traversal time through a data structure as well as the build/update times, making grids appealing for ray tracing animated scenes.
